noun_definition: Expense refers to a submitted financial request made by user A to user B within a Collect workspace, which can be marked as a duplicate.
Hold refers to the action of temporarily pausing the processing of an expense submitted by a user, which in this case is a duplicate expense.
Message refers to the notification indicating that an expense is a duplicate, which appears in the transaction preview when an expense is put on hold.
Transaction preview refers to the display that shows the status of expenses, including messages like `Duplicate`, when a user interacts with submitted expenses in the Collect workspace.
